Overcharged Emitter.desc: Upgrade one damage die by one step; if the weapon has multiple damage dice, choose one die.
Overcharged Emitter.notes: On a critical failure (both trait and Wild Die show 1), the weapon overheats and cannot fire until cleared with a full action.

Extended Barrel.desc: Improve the long end of the weapon's listed range by +1/+2/+4.

Gyro-Stabilized Grip.desc: Ignore 1 point of Shooting penalty from running or unstable platform.

Collimating Optics.desc: Negate 1 point of range penalties when shooting at medium or long range.

Integrated Targeting Laser.desc: +1 Shooting on the first aimed attack each combat with this weapon. While aiming, foes gain +1 Notice to detect you.

Plasma Agitator.desc: +2 AP on attacks made with this weapon (add to the weapon's listed AP, if any). If the weapon's total AP including this mod is greater than 3 and you roll a critical failure on Shooting with this weapon, the weapon is damaged until repaired (−2 to the Mechanics roll to fix it); the Plasma Agitator is destroyed and cannot be salvaged.
Plasma Agitator.notes: Critical failure: both the trait die and Wild Die show 1, or a 1 on the trait die with no Wild Die (SWADE).

Suppressed Barrel.desc: Suppresses firing sound. Enemies attempting to locate the shooter by sound make Notice at -1.
Suppressed Barrel.notes: Range bands reduced by 2/4/8 (short/medium/long) — suppressors trade reach for silence.

Secondary Power Cell.desc: Once per scene, ignore one reload, jam, or 'out of power' complication from this weapon.

Under-Barrel Micro-Launcher.desc: Once per combat, Shooting attack using the weapon's skill; on hit, 2d6 frag, medium blast template. Range —/12/24. Rifles only (requires 3 hard points). Reload 100 cr.

Helmet HUD / Macrovisor.desc: +1 Notice at long range while the helmet is sealed or the visor is deployed.
Helmet HUD / Macrovisor.notes: Does not stack with Macrobinoculars on the same check unless GM allows.

Mag-Plate Weave.desc: Ignore the first hit's weapon AP, once per combat. −1 Stealth rolls.

Stealth-Dampening Weave.desc: +2 to Stealth on any round you do not run and do not attack.

Repulsor Jump Pack.desc: Once per scene, use a move action to launch vertically or horizontally up to 6"+d6". You may still act normally this round but cannot spend any additional actions to move. Useful for vaulting obstacles, reaching elevated positions, or closing distance in a single burst.
Repulsor Jump Pack.notes: Requires a scene to recharge. Landing in melee range of an enemy does not trigger a free attack against you. Cannot be used while Prone.

Sling Mount.desc: Rifles only. The weapon is considered always readied while worn — draw or stow it as a free action. Lets you switch between rifle and sidearm without losing an action.
